instruction: Repo owner, live in this conversation, directly and explicitly instructed: update the change log and the version, commit that, then merge this branch (feature/now-playing-desktop-layout) into master and push to the remote. Branch rearranges the Now Playing page's desktop layout (Now Playing + PlaybackControls as a left column, Up Next as a right column at lg+) and pulls the lyrics panel out into its own section at every breakpoint instead of nesting it inside the Now Playing card. Includes a commit (6c69d97) bumping config.yaml 1.0.29 -> 1.0.30 with a matching CHANGELOG.md entry.
notes: Preflight before this record: backend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; backend `npx vitest run` 417/417 passing; frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; frontend `npm run build` clean. Layout visually verified in the Browser pane against the local dev servers at desktop (two-column) and mobile (375px, single-column stacked) widths; both dev servers stopped afterward and `scripts/check-stray-backend.mjs` confirmed nothing left listening. master HEAD at time of this record: 7fe13181ff727a1e2b71a9f59c0e9550fdfd1b9d. Action taken: `git checkout master`; `git merge --no-ff feature/now-playing-desktop-layout -m "Merge feature/now-playing-desktop-layout: Now Playing desktop grid layout + standalone lyrics section, 1.0.30 version bump"` -> clean merge (ort strategy, no conflicts), producing 2cbd6ece0ba9a7b8c4456a5c86b18255faad040e on master.
